# Peer Review

**Arguments:** "$ARGUMENTS"

1. Find the Orc-istration checkout: the "Setup checkout (this machine)" line in the rulebook's tool notes, else `setupCheckout` in `config.json` (under `ORC_DATA_DIR` when set, else under `~/.orc/`), else ask the user. Call it CHECKOUT and confirm `CHECKOUT/workflows/peer-review.md` exists there; if it does not, stop and say so.
2. Read `CHECKOUT/workflows/README.md`, then `CHECKOUT/workflows/peer-review.md`, and follow it with these arguments. Run the review panel in this session by following `CHECKOUT/review/PROCEDURE.md`, launching its explorers in one message, each with `run_in_background: true`; dispatch every agent by its roster name as `subagent_type`; ask the developer with `AskUserQuestion`.
